recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is recommended for FHIR-12953; reintroducing the original SHALL-style inline inference wording would conflict with the later FHIR-17628, FHIR-23128, and FHIR-28305 decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-12953 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2 issue asking to clarify Questionnaire.item.definition as a URI to an ElementDefinition that can supply metadata about the item, including information that might otherwise appear in the Questionnaire instance, with the accepted resolution using an absent-item inference rule.
initial_application: The broad git-svn commit 37ee370c54dfacfae4832dc5c7a51bef52968f80, 'Applied Questionnaire trackers', appears to have applied the seed by replacing the older item.definition text with the URI/ElementDefinition wording and an inline derived-property list. That initial application over-stated precedence by saying values SHALL be inferred from the ElementDefinition rather than corresponding Questionnaire instance elements.
additional_context: FHIR-17628 directly corrected that over-stated precedence and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 31820782523db8f803552cc68bcc9769a1d23f8b. FHIR-23128 later moved the obsolete inline list out of the element definition and into the notes, and FHIR-28305 removed item.type from the derived-property list while warning that Questionnaires should carry enough inline information for systems that cannot resolve definitions.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope source keeps Questionnaire active, defines item.definition as a URI to ElementDefinition or ObservationDefinition, links to the Question Definitions notes, lists derivable values there, and states that Questionnaire-provided information overrides the external definition.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the FHIR-12953 application so ElementDefinition-derived values do not override Questionnaire item values; already audited on the combined branch.
Removed the obsolete inline derived-property list from Questionnaire.item.definition and made Questionnaire notes the detailed guidance surface.
Removed item.type from definition-derived properties and clarified mandatory Questionnaire.item.type alignment with ElementDefinition.type.
Clarified that item.type and similar values must still be specified on Questionnaire even when inferable from a definition.
